reviews.comment: This class is no where near as hard as she tells you it will be. just watch the video lectures on 15 speed and take notes, you will pass. The TA sucks hardcore if you need help go the prof because Logan is not helpful at all.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Linneman over-exaggerates the difficulty of this class. Her tests are honestly not difficult. Also don't waste time on reading the textbook! The main thing is do not get behind on lecture videos. You get stuck with the partner you choose. She is very organized & her instructions for assignments are super clear! I ended up with a 100.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: 3 tests and 7 assignments. Class was online with zoom lectures and yt lectures for each test. Horrible lecturer, you're better off just watching the yt lectures and taking notes (on 2x). She spends the first week preaching how "hard" her tests are. Don't believe her. Watch all the lectures and take notes and you'll be fine. Also the TA sucks lmao
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class is hard for no reason. I think she prides herself on making tests hard. You aren't allowed to go back once you answer a question (while only having about 1 minute per question). The assignments are NOT nearly as hard as she claims they are. I always attended class and watched the lecture videos and still got a B.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The professor is good, she definitely overestimates the difficulty of this class and assignments. If you watch the lectures and read the instructions clearly you will be fine. The TA sucks, she is a slow grader and she doesn't provide any help or guidance that the professor can't.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This is a difficult class but I would say she is one of the best professors to take it from. Professor Linneman has class once a week held online but, has posted all of the lectures with the test and project material on canvas that you watch on your own time and is very time-consuming. You will have 5 group projects so be cautious when choosing.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The class isn't super hard, but the content can get very confusing. She doesn't do normal lectures on class days, instead, she does class one day a week and posts roughly 10 lecture videos that are an hour (ish) long for each unit. The group projects can be hit or miss depending on your partner and they take a while to finish. Not an easy A at all
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She's a great professor for the class, her TA is super helpful if you message her. Definitely watch her lectures and attend classes. There's 3 exams and several group projects but she gives you step by step instructions. Easy A if you pay attention/take good notes/study. Can't go back to change answers on exams. Extra credit offered on assignments.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: She was nice and the TA was helpful. This course would have been better in person. Choosing a partner for team assignments would have been better in person since online we were randomly assigned, so you're stuck with who you got. She's a strict grader, and since tests were online you couldn't go back and change answers which is a disadvantage.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class is such an easy A, take it with her and you will love it.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: DONT take this class if you aren't a fan of unnecessary work!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Her class is very hard and she is sweet but her class is hard. If you do not go to class might as well Q-drop. This class is test heavy and there is no extra credit.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: To be honest, if you have a hard time understanding teachers at 8 o'clock in the morning do not take her. Also, if you are not a good test taker do not take her. This class is extremely test heavy, and she gives no test reviews. She is available during office times, but does not care about her students unless you go to her office hours.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. Linneman does not seem to care a great deal about her students until you talk to her in person; that's where her concern for you really shines. I found her to be a very gentle and caring person when speaking one-on-one. The tests are directly from the slides. Prepare ahead of time and you'll be fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: This class is a handful but she's the best prof if you're a soci major. You have few grades, so double check your work on the assignments because every point counts. The swemester long project is tedious but very useful and the lectures are most helpful - start it AS SOON AS YOU GET IT ASSIGNED. You can't do it in one night unless you plan to fail.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I absolutely LOVED Dr. Linneman. She was such an awesome professor and would take her again if I could. She's visually impaired so there are things you have to do to accommodate for that, but it's not a big adjustment. Get started on the group project early and you'll do fine! Tests are very straight forward and Linneman makes the class easy.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Linneman was an amazing prof for my Soci 220 class. She is incredibly knowledgeable, always prepared to offer help on whatever you need, and teaches you everything you need to know. However you must do the work and put in effort to do well. DO NOT SLACK OFF! Going to class and staying on top of the group project are essential to a good grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Dr. Linneman is a really kind professor available for office hours often if you need additional help. Unfortunately she is very boring, and grades harshly on exams and the group project. Do the assignments they are easy. Go to class because the powerpoints have many blanks, and there is a sign in sheet for attendance which is not graded.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Linneman is a very caring professor. She does demonstrations in class that help you understand the material so even though attendance is not mandatory, GO! Group project can be hard but pay attention in class and start working on the group project as soon as you can and meet frequently! Would take her again!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Dr. Linneman is a great teacher. She explains the concepts really well and she cares about what she's teaching. A great choice but she also makes you work hard to get a good grade. 3 exams, no final, none are cumulative. Group project is a beating.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: The group project is not terribly hard but make sure you choose a good group & get started immediately so that you are not stressed at the end of the semester. The tests were not as hard as she will make you believe they are. The assignments are easy points so do not mess up on those. Her lectures are straight to the point also! Amazing professor!

You really have to study and know what you are talking about. Group project is noooo joke! Start the day you get the project and you will be fine. Wait and you will be rushing and hate your life. She is very outgoing and if you go to her office hours, you will understand the material if you just ask questions.

Group project is grueling but helpful to learn material. Linneman s FANTASTIC. She's a great teacher and really helpful. Tough but really fair and understanding!! I wish she taught upper level. Don't skip, know your notes and you'll do well. Projects help your grade

AMAZING professor!! She is funny, sweet and knows the material very well. Tough tests - go to lecture, take notes and listen & you should have no problem! 3 easy assignments help your grade - just don't make silly mistakes; Group project is HORRIBLE - I had to do the entire project by myself but Dr. Linneman helped me whenever I needed it!

One of the best professors I've ever had. She explains everything thoroughly, all you have to do is pay attention and take notes. Tests are challenging, but if you study well and know the material, you'll do fine. The group project is a pain, but she is extremely helpful and gives clear, detailed instructions for every part. Highly recommend.

Amazing prof who knows what she's talking about. Decades of experience and nearly perfected teaching technique. The group project is helpful. Don't have to read much or write a whole lot, but must pay attention in lectures and understand the material well. Best prof I've ever had.

amazing teacher really know what she is talking about. Test are very hard. she expects you to know and understand every little detail. The group project is a huge pain but it counts for a test grade which can help. Be prepared to put in LOTSSS of work to get an A
